# AegisAi Harness — agent-readable catalog

A feature-rich, local-only AI agent harness. CLI-first, offline-first.

## Capabilities
- Multi-backend LLM adapter (Ollama + OpenAI-compatible)
- Agent loop with tool calls, fallback models, token budgeting
- Tool registry with capability filtering, clean room, sandbox rings
- MCP client (stdio + HTTP), mock MCP fixtures
- Context compaction + retrievable archive
- Hooks (beforeModel, afterModel, beforeTool, afterTool, PermissionRequest, SessionStart/End, PostModelCall)
- Doom-loop detection, composable stop conditions
- Named agents/profiles, subagents, handoffs, parallel tool calls
- Deterministic replay, tracing, eval harness, benchmark suites
- Policy engine, guardrails, encrypted vault, backup/restore
- Web UI (--web), Tauri desktop scaffold, offline update checker
- Code indexing + repo map, skill import + auto-create, decision memory

## Entry points
- `node src/index.js "<prompt>"` — one-shot
- `node src/index.js --repl` — interactive REPL
- `node src/index.js --web` — web UI
- `node src/index.js --proxy` — OpenAI-compatible proxy
- `node src/index.js --update` — version check
